info.name: Masar API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for the Masar ride-hailing backend.

Base URL: `{{baseUrl}}` (default: `http://localhost:3000/api/v1`)

All endpoints are versioned under `/api/v1/`.

Authentication uses JWT tokens stored in cookies (`accessToken` and `refreshToken`), which are set automatically on login/register responses.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints for user login, registration, logout, and token refresh.

Tokens are returned as HTTP-only cookies.

request.description:
Register a new user account.

Sets `accessToken` and `refreshToken` cookies on success.

**Validation:**
- `name`: string, required, max 100 chars
- `phone`: string, required, max 15 chars
- `email`: valid email, required, max 100 chars
- `password`: string, required, min 8 / max 100 chars

Authenticate an existing user.

Sets `accessToken` and `refreshToken` cookies on success.

**Validation:**
- `email`: valid email, required, max 100 chars
- `password`: string, required, max 100 chars

Log out the current session.

Requires a valid `refreshToken` cookie.

Clears both `accessToken` and `refreshToken` cookies.

**Auth:** Refresh JWT (cookie)

Refresh the access and refresh tokens.

Requires a valid `refreshToken` cookie. Issues new tokens and updates the cookies.

**Auth:** Refresh JWT (cookie)

item.name: Users
item.description:
User management endpoints.

**Auth:** Requires JWT access token (cookie).
**Roles:** Admin only.

request.description:
Delete all users from the system.

**Auth:** JWT (cookie)
**Role:** `ADMIN` only

item.name: Sessions
item.description:
Session management endpoints.

**Auth:** Requires JWT access token (cookie).

request.description:
Retrieve all active sessions for the currently authenticated user.

**Auth:** JWT (cookie)

item.name: Rides
item.description: Ride management endpoints for creating, listing, and accepting rides.

request.description:
Create a new ride request.

**Auth:** None required

**Validation:**
- `startLocation`: object with `lat` (number) and `lng` (number), required
- `endLocation`: object with `lat` (number) and `lng` (number), required
- `cost`: number, required

variable.description: UUID of the ride to accept

request.description:
Accept a pending ride as a driver.

The driver is identified from the authenticated user's JWT.

**Auth:** JWT (cookie)

**Path params:**
- `rideId`: UUID of the ride

Register a new driver profile.

**Auth:** None required

**Validation:**
- `name`: string, required, max 100 chars
- `vehicleType`: enum (`van`, `car`, `truck`), required
- `phone`: string, required, max 15 chars
- `email`: valid email, required, max 100 chars
- `password`: string, required, min 8 / max 100 chars
- `driverLicenseId`: string, required, max 100 chars
